newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektromontaz plans PLN 12.87 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Elektromontaz plans PLN 12.87 mln bonds.

text.p: Polish construction company Elektromontaz Export SA plans to issue 12.87 million zlotys worth of convertible bonds due 2000, it said in a statement.
Elektromontaz said on Wednesday the board's proposal to issue 130 bonds with a par value of 99,000 zlotys each would be voted at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on October 30.
It also said another meeting on November 14 would vote on a proposal to issue up to 2.34 million new shares to be taken up in exchange for the bonds. @

Elektromontaz said the bonds, carrying an annual eight-percent coupon, would be offered at or above par in a private placement and bond holders would be entitled to exchange each bond for 18,000 new shares.
